# s4communication_inbound_user (Resource)

Inbound User of a Communication System

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Allows the communication user to call this system's inbound services
resource "s4communication_inbound_user" "example" {
  communication_system_uuid = s4communication_communication_system.example.id
  communication_user_id     = s4communication_communication_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `communication_system_uuid` (String) UUID of the Communication System this inbound user belongs to. Changing this forces a new inbound user to be created.
- `communication_user_id` (String) Communication User ID (max 12 characters)

### Optional

- `authentication_method` (String) Authentication Method, defaults to `basic` (max 20 characters)
- `is_oauth2_refresh_token_allowed` (Boolean) OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token Allowed
- `oauth2_client_id` (String) OAuth 2.0 Client ID (max 40 characters)
- `oauth2_grant_type` (String) OAuth 2.0 Grant Type (max 20 characters)
- `oauth2_refresh_token_expiry_unit` (String) OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token Expiry Unit (max 6 characters)
- `oauth2_refresh_token_expiry_value` (Number) OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token Expiry Value

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Inbound User UUID (internal identifier)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 and later: import with the resource identity, as listed by
# terraform query
import {
  to = s4communication_inbound_user.example
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Inbound user UUID

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Inbound users are imported by their UUID
terraform import s4communication_inbound_user.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
